55/S0.subgoal: Introduce the graphics-pipeline context by recapping frame-buffer basics and explaining that frame-buffer values are computed in stages.

55/S1.subgoal: Describe the 3D graphics pipeline stages and the coordinate systems involved in transforming objects to pixels.

55/S2.subgoal: Explain the trade-offs in object representation and list the broad categories of 3D object representation.

55/S3.subgoal: Describe point-sample rendering and boundary/mesh representation as broad object-representation categories.

55/S4.subgoal: Explain spline and parametric representation for curved surfaces.

55/S5.subgoal: Describe space partitioning representation and specialized techniques for complex photorealistic objects.

55/S6.subgoal: Summarize the lecture's main points and note that implementation order of pipeline stages may vary.
